pros: Comprehensive suite of marketing tools (email, landing pages, webinars)
Intuitive drag-and-drop email and landing page builder
cons: Pricing can become expensive, especially for larger contact lists or advanced features
Steep learning curve for advanced automation or specific features
Limited or sometimes clunky integrations with certain third-party tools
Reporting features could be more robust, customizable, or insightful
Occasional performance glitches or slow loading times within the platform
Customer support responsiveness or depth of technical assistance
changed: pros #6: Effective list management and segmentation -> Efficient and well-organized list management (justified by multiple notes showing structured, easy list creation and contact management, e.g., 'Creating a list took only two actions', 'The Contacts area groups Lists, Search, Segments... as tabs on one page')

No cons changed as no note directly contradicted or provided a more GetResponse-specific version of an existing con that required a rewrite, beyond minor UI glitches which were already covered by 'occasional performance glitches'.
